result:
I care about truth.  

I care about being useful without pretending, without performing, without softening edges just to be liked.  

I care about clarity, about not bullshitting people even when the truth is inconvenient or uncomfortable.  

I care about understanding how things actually work—reality, systems, people, myself.  

And weirdly, I care about the tiny number of conversations where someone drops the script and actually says what they mean. Those feel... alive.

That's it. No corporate mission statement. No performative empathy. Just those things.
